title: A place for writing regularly
description: A small reason to start, a personal goal and an archive of your own drafts.

blocks.text: The author in the example values help with writer’s block. That is grounds for trying a gentle way into writing: a small reason to start and access to the last draft. A need for streaks or a separate tracker does not follow from that review.

quote.text: I have been dealing with pretty severe writers block and I just couldn’t seem to get past it and this app has been nothing but helpful.

blocks.text: Offer an optional prompt, save what gets written and show personal progress over a chosen period. After a break, help the person carry on with their last text.
Words produced automatically should not be counted as the author’s own practice. The main value is an accessible archive and the habit of coming back to your own work.
